subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently maintain this Microsoft inventory in a committed generated file, in a working PR body, or only through GitHub-native labels, searches, or project views?
rationale: Both tracker attempts remain unmerged drafts, while merging this branch would establish an ongoing generated artifact and privileged GitHub mutation workflow without a confirmed canonical owner or maintenance contract.

options.title: Keep PR-Body Tracker
options.body: Use the working PR body as the canonical living inventory and remove the committed tracker, generator, and release-owned changelog change.

options.title: Adopt Repository Tracker
options.body: Sponsor the committed tracker with a named owner, safe mutation semantics, generate/check commands, and a documented refresh workflow.

options.title: Use GitHub-Native Views
options.body: Close the tracker experiment and rely on labels, searches, or a GitHub project as the maintained inventory.

recommendation.title: Keep PR-Body Tracker
recommendation.body: Use the working PR body as the canonical living inventory and remove the committed tracker, generator, and release-owned changelog change.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent repository automation ownership and broad product authority make this the best available owner for selecting the permanent maintainer workflow.
